title: Ordered Product of Probability Laws
statement: Let $D$ be a finite set, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and assign a probability law on $D$ to each coordinate in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. The ordered product law on coordinate assignments is formed by sampling the coordinates independently according to their respective laws; when $n=0$, it is concentrated on the unique assignment on the empty coordinate set.
hypotheses_covered: Each coordinate in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ is assigned a probability law on $D$
